purpose: Review evidence, not a scanner suppression policy. Locations and hashes refer to the immutable baseline; repeated flows remain separate findings.

scope.python_environment: CPython 3.12 macOS; uv.lock all groups/all extras, evaluated markers
scope.iac: snyk iac test deploy returned no supported IaC files (Docker Compose is not a supported IaC target); not counted as a passing scan.
scope.containers: Built final runtime images, linux/arm64; both OS inventory and application packages, no base-image exclusions.

native_dom.rationale: The sink is native DOM append/replaceChildren, not jQuery HTML parsing. Labels use textContent or SVG text nodes. Full exported HTML is exercised with hostile labels; executable documentation URLs found during this review are separately fixed.

fixture.rationale: Synthetic credentials or secrets in a test fixture, including deliberate invalid/expired credential tests. No issued production credential is present. Replacing negative controls would weaken the tests.

build_secret.rationale: Explicit local benchmark/build placeholder. Benchmark and build environments are selected by the operator; these values are not production defaults or issued credentials.

operator_path.rationale: Local tool file paths are intentionally selected by its invoking operator (CLI arguments, environment, or versioned benchmark recipes). No HTTP/tenant input reaches this operation; the tool already executes operator-selected project code. This is not a sandbox for hostile projects.

environment_path.rationale: The heartbeat/Prometheus location is deployment configuration controlled by the process operator, not request input. The operator can already select executable code and files accessible to this process.

validated_release_path.rationale: Artifact basenames are derived from an allowlisted package and validated version; manifest rows are checked by validate_manifest/validate_local_artifacts before copying. PyPI filenames cannot introduce paths.

validated_export_path.rationale: Public-source policy validates relative paths, reviewed symlinks, Git tracking and file hashes. Export requires a new destination outside the checkout, rechecks the policy and removes only that newly created destination on failure.

command_argv.rationale: The local benchmark/CI runner deliberately launches operator-selected tools/project code using an argument vector without shell interpolation. Arbitrary executable selection is its documented local function, not an application command-injection boundary.

recipe_shell.rationale: This smoke runner intentionally executes command lines from the repository-owned versioned recipe through a shell, as a user would. It does not accept remote recipes or application requests.

project_import.rationale: This explicit local mutation/import-audit command intentionally imports operator-selected project modules. It is not used by cold graph/context reads or by web requests.

xml_local.rationale: XML comes from repository-owned SVG assets or the local test subprocess JUnit output. Supported Python is >=3.11; the Snyk recommendation targets Python <3.11. No external DTD or untrusted web XML is accepted here.

auth_label.rationale: The strings user/service/public are route authentication classification labels, not passwords or credentials.

git_hash.rationale: SHA-1 is required by the Git blob identifier protocol; usedforsecurity=False now makes the non-security purpose explicit. Not used for authentication, signing or password hashing.

namespace_hash.rationale: SHA-1 only derives a deterministic local test database/resource namespace. usedforsecurity=False now makes that purpose explicit. It protects no secret or security decision.

rsa_negative.rationale: The deliberately weak RSA key verifies that the JWT implementation rejects undersized keys. This is a negative security regression, not a generated production key.

test_sql.rationale: The extraction integration test deliberately issues SQL against its disposable test database with fixture-defined identifiers. It does not expose an application query interface.

task_regex.rationale: Task names are validated with _NAME.fullmatch ([a-z][a-z0-9_]*) before interpolation, excluding regex metacharacters.

topology_regex.rationale: The local load-test topology intentionally contains operator-authored route regular expressions. There is no web or tenant supplied regex in this code path.

docs_http.rationale: Documentation smoke tests intentionally execute repository quickstart/tutorial commands and poll their local test server. They are not an HTTP proxy or externally reachable URL fetcher.

backup_identifier.rationale: Restoration checks now quote schema/table/column identifiers with psycopg2.sql.Identifier, including composite foreign keys. A real PostgreSQL regression covers embedded quotes and SQL comment markers with valid and orphaned rows.

dataset_identifier.rationale: Benchmark counts/VACUUM now quote catalog-provided identifiers and escape embedded double quotes. Real PostgreSQL regression uses a table named odd";-- table.

tar_filter.rationale: All three source extraction sites share _extract_source_archive using the data filter. Regressions reject escaping symbolic/hard links and special files, while preserving safe links and executable files.

private_profiler.rationale: The profiler bind-mount directory remains private (0700); Docker runs under the invoking UID/GID instead of chmod 0777. The regression verifies both and a real container writes under that identity.

additional_fix.rationale: Restrict documentation href protocols to HTTP/HTTPS; reject executable schemes in imported graph metadata. Regression tests execute the actual full HTML export.

sca.rationale: Removed patch-package and its braces/picomatch 2 dependency chain.

No upstream fixed version is available. The pinned parser rejects the vulnerable single-branch repeated wildcard extglob before regex construction. Snyk still reports the package version; no ignore is added.
Ajv 6 now resolves the maintained fast-uri 4.2.3 alias instead of uri-js; actual schema references and advisory inputs are regression tested.

remaining_sanitized_sinks: The three SQL results remain flagged despite Identifier/escaped-double-quote composition; real PostgreSQL regressions verify them.

repeat_code_scan.review: All remaining rule/file pairs are covered by the original per-finding dispositions. Nine DOM results, two non-security hashes, one permission result and two duplicate tar sites disappear without ignores.
